{{Quote|Emperor of numberless worlds... ''Lord Vader's'' throne still remains empty. Have you now come to take his place and ''join us''?|A Dark Lord of the Sith, to Palpatine|<ref name="EE 2" />}}
The '''Tomb of Darth Vader''' was a [[Burial/Legends|burial]] place prepared in the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to hold the remains of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="EE 2" />

The tomb was never used for its original purpose.<ref name="EE 2" /> Anakin Skywalker renounced the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and the title of Darth Vader in the final moments of his life as he killed [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and fulfilled the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] prophecy. Having died embracing the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]], his body became [[Force ghost/Legends|one with the Force]], and his son [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Cremation/Legends|cremated]] his empty [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] a short time later.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[11 ABY/Legends|Seven years later]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> an ancient [[Unidentified Dark Lord (Great Temple)|Dark Lord of the Sith]] offered Darth Vader's vacant tomb to the [[Cloning/Legends|reborn]] Palpatine, whose store of clone bodies were rapidly deteriorating. Palpatine declined the offer as he intended to rule [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for all eternity.<ref name="EE 2" />
